_comment: Copy to settings.json to use it. Leave values empty for interactive sign-in. Certificate auth only - never put client secrets in this file.

Session._comment: Sign-ins also always end at midnight, when the PC sleeps and when the toolkit closes. MaxAgeHours: 1-24, IdleMinutes: 1-1440.

Runtimes._comment: Interpreters for non-PowerShell modules. Empty = found automatically (bash/zsh: WSL, then Git Bash; Python: py launcher, then python.exe). A path set here is the only one used. Arguments go before the script, e.g. ["-e", "bash"] for wsl.exe.
